bar: LM-test CI excludes zero; gold-58 difference >= -0.024 (ticket 03).
bootstrap: Paired study bootstrap, 2,000 resamples shared across arms (seed 2030).

steps.change: Baseline. DINOv2-small adapted contrastively (LoRA, last 6 blocks) and then frozen; 3-seed MLP head on LM verdicts. Not fine-tuned on labels.
steps.label: R0 · frozen contrastive encoder + LM MLP head

steps.change: Trains the encoder on the labels: the last 3 blocks of plain pretrained DINOv2-small and an MLP head, end to end, on hard LM verdicts. 3 slices per plane, 224 px.
steps.label: R1 · fine-tune on hard labels

steps.change: Targets change from hard verdicts to the CSV's soft values. Selection still uses hard-label BCE.
steps.label: R2 · soft labels

steps.change: Input resolution rises from 224 to 336 px.
steps.label: R3 · 336 px

steps.change: R1, but initialised from R0's contrastive checkpoint (its LoRA over the last 6 blocks stays trainable) instead of plain DINOv2-small.
steps.label: R1c · start from R0's encoder

steps.change: Each training read draws one random slice per third of the 0.2–0.8 band, per plane. Evaluation keeps the fixed slices.
steps.label: R1c · random training slices

steps.change: Each plane becomes 8 contiguous 3-slice windows, one per depth stratum (jittered in training, centred at evaluation), mean-pooled under a validity mask. Batch 4 × accumulation 4 keeps the effective batch at 16.
steps.label: R4a · 8 windows per plane, masked mean

steps.change: Mean pooling becomes single-head attention: 12 label queries over all 24 windows, with a plane embedding. The head is ~112k parameters against R4a's ~200k.
steps.label: R4b · per-label attention

steps.change: 16 windows per plane instead of 8. About 21% of planes are now short stacks with masked windows.
steps.label: R4a · 16 windows per plane

steps.change: Starts from plain pretrained DINOv2-small (last 3 blocks trainable) instead of R0's contrastive checkpoint. The matched control for the backbone swaps below.
steps.label: R4a K8 · DINOv2-small from pretrained

steps.change: Swaps only the pretrained weights: OmniRad-small is the same ViT-S/14 trained with DINOv2 on RadImageNet (CT, MRI, ultrasound).
steps.label: R4a K8 · OmniRad-small

steps.change: RadImageNet weights trained with original DINO, at patch 16 (196 tokens per window instead of 256).
steps.label: R4a K8 · RadioDino-s16

steps.change: OmniRad at ViT-B/14 (86M parameters, 4× DINOv2-small). Changes both pretraining data and size; the DINOv2-base control is not run yet.
steps.label: R4a K8 · OmniRad-base

steps.change: R2's change on R4a: targets become the CSV's soft LM values instead of hard verdicts.
steps.label: R4a K8 · soft labels

steps.change: Replicate: identical to R4a K8 except the training seed (2027 instead of 2026). Measures seed noise.
steps.label: R4a K8 · seed 2027

steps.change: Replicate: identical to OmniRad-base except the training seed (2027 instead of 2026).
steps.label: R4a K8 · OmniRad-base, seed 2027

steps.change: R3's change on R4a: input resolution rises from 224 to 336 px (576 tokens per window instead of 256), on a new K8 336 window cache. Starts from pretrained DINOv2-small because R0 is fixed at 224.
steps.label: R4a K8 · DINOv2-small pretrained, 336 px

steps.change: Stacks the two single-change wins on OmniRad-base: soft LM targets (from R4a soft) and 336 px input (from DINOv2-S 336), batch 2 × accumulation 8. Two changes at once, so the delta is not attributable.
steps.label: R4a K8 · OmniRad-base, soft labels, 336 px

steps.change: Backbone diagnostic: timm coatnet_rmlp_2_rw_384 (ImageNet-12k → 1k, 73M parameters, the backbone of a reported 0.924 public single model) through the same K8 soft recipe at 384 px. Last 3 of 24 blocks trainable (26.6M parameters); stem and stages 0–2 stay at ImageNet weights with BatchNorm frozen. Pooled feature is [spatial max, mean] since CoAtNet has no CLS. Changes backbone and resolution against run 5.
steps.label: R4a K8 · CoAtNet-384, soft labels (ticket 16)
